A familiar lull ahead, a simple notice
The subject is staff rotas
Travelers, please read this now: companion animal checks at Aurelia Skyways need steady planning, and some desk shifts may change without much warning.

Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping a close watch so pets move through the process with calm handling and clear care. Please have all papers ready at the counter, and keep carriers secure while staff review them.

For birds, <<FACT F065>>. For cats, <<FACT F079>>. If your animal is due for review, bring the needed documents early so the team can keep things moving and avoid delays.

If you are unsure about a carrier, a health paper, or a handoff step, come straight to the desk before you head onward. The staff will sort the next step and keep the line moving. Companion Animal Travel Desk
